name: Tool Selection
description: LLM judge assessing whether the agent picked the right tool(s) for the task at each decision point.

expectedInputs.description: Tool calls made by the agent. When no tool-call data was captured the evaluator is skipped (not measured); a captured empty list is judged.
The case's expected actions; their required tools are sent to the judge (fenced as data) as the tools that should have been called.
